summary: Netron is a graphical tool used to inspect and visualise neural network and machine learning model architectures. It parses file formats from various machine learning frameworks to render a node-based diagram of the computational graph. This helps you understand the structure, layers, and tensor shapes of a given model file.
goodFor: Machine learning engineers and researchers who need to debug, audit, or present model architectures without writing custom parsing scripts.
watchOut: It is primarily a visualisation utility rather than an end-to-end training platform or model repository, so you will need to pair it with other tools for actual model management.
deployNotes: As an application built with Python and Node.js, it typically requires a standard runtime environment and a reverse proxy if you intend to expose the interface securely over the web with TLS.
